name: march
description: Sketch backend and frontend architecture on a canvas -- drag typed shapes or hand-draw them -- and generate real, runnable code from it via your own coding agent CLI (Claude Code by default, any CLI-based agent supported).

march.agentBin.description: Path to your coding agent's CLI binary. Defaults to the Claude Code CLI, but any CLI-based agent that opens an interactive chat with no arguments works. If March can't run it, it'll ask you to locate it and save the result here.

march.agentArgs.description: Flags used only for Autodiscover's one-shot, non-interactive run (it needs a real exit code, unlike Generate's interactive session). Defaults match the Claude Code CLI -- change these if march.agentBin points at a different agent with different non-interactive flags.
